result: Krylov subspace (Lanczos) solutions of the non-convex trust-region and cubic-regularized problems converge linearly once t ≳ √κ and sublinearly (∝ 1/t²) before, with bounds that are tight; a random perturbation fixes the hard case.
result_plain: Lanczos solves the non-convex trust-region subproblem at sharp linear and sublinear rates; perturb to fix the hard case.
